description: PySCF analytic nonadiabatic couplings of the density-fitted state-averaged CASSCF (pyscf.nac.sacasscf over df.grad.sacasscf), over this tree's data/basis and data/aux_basis files, each case's CASSCF and its _scf sharing one fit. Per ordered pair (bra I, ket J): d_IJ = <I|dJ/dR> (total), without the CSF term (etf), the CSF term (csf), h_IJ, its Hellmann-Feynman and Lagrange halves, the transition RDMs, the orbital gradient b and the multipliers z. Hartree, bohr; row A, column k is d/dR_Ak
